content:
BUILT CoLAB presents here one of its associates, Contacto Atlântico!

Contacto Atlântico is an architecture studio, founded by architect André Caiado in 1996. Since the beginning it has worked on a wide range of national and international projects, having recently been recognised for several rehabilitation works carried out in the Lisbon Urban Area.


In addition to architecture, Contacto Atlântico specialises in project analysis and management, with the aim of offering its clients the best guidance and advice. It sees every project as an opportunity to turn an idea into a real object, always seeking the best way to express it in reality, using for that purpose the best technological tools on the market, something essential for optimising the tasks of everyone involved in the projects, from the preliminary study through to the completion of the works.

It also relies on a dedicated and qualified team, with a deep understanding of every aspect of architectural practice. The variety of contexts and skills of each team member ensures not only a correct understanding of the projects developed, but also a broad creative spectrum throughout the work process.

Discover all BUILT CoLAB's associates here.
